name: CJ Olive Young

figures.source: Seoulz (Olive Young Global 2026 profile) — share of the health-and-beauty STORE channel, NOT of total Korean cosmetics retail

read: The single most important gatekeeper in Korean domestic BPC: KRW 5.83tn in 2025, +21.8%, across roughly 1,350-1,370 stores, and reportedly more than 85% of the H&B store channel (Seoulz, LOW). The health-and-beauty channel is itself put at 54.1% of Korean cosmetics distribution (Mordor, LOW) — both figures are aggregator-grade and the repo flags them as conflicting with other channel reads, so treat the concentration as directionally strong and numerically soft. Two consequences for entry: any Korea-facing plan is really an Olive Young listing plan, which makes buyer power the binding force in KR; and its revenue is retailer sell-through, so it cannot be compared with the brand owners' net realisation or added to any market total.
